item.title: Gemini 2.5 Pro in ASK mode made changes

labels.name: bug
labels.description: Issue identified by VS Code Team member as probable bug

item.body:
Type: Bug I asked Copilot chat about whether I was missing any tests for a specific function. I included the test file (current context) and mentioned the function by symbol reference. It opted to use Workspace /tests. After thinking for a bit, it made suggested changes to my test file and output just "Made changes." in the chat.
